zacchaeus.t: [男子名] 扎基厄斯来源于希伯来语，含义是“正直的人，纯洁的”(the righteous one,pure)

zachariah.t: [圣]撒迦利亚 (①施洗者约翰之父 ②耶稣称为殉道的人 ③男子名)

zacharias.t: n. 扎卡赖亚斯,撒迦利亚,殉道者撒迦利亚
zacharias.d:
n a Hebrew minor prophet of the late 6th century BC
n an Old Testament book telling the prophecies of Zechariah which are concerned mainly with the renewal of Israel after the Babylonian Captivity

zamzummim.t: n. [基督教]散送冥人(《圣经·旧约》提及的巨人族)

zaza.t: n. (Zaza)人名；(意、利比、阿拉伯)扎扎

zeal.t: n. 热心, 热衷, 热诚
zeal.d: n. excessive fervor to do something or accomplish some end

zealot.t:
n. 热心者, 狂热者, 犹太教狂热信徒
[法] 狂热分子, 激烈分子
zealot.d: n. a member of an ancient Jewish sect in Judea in the first century who fought to the death against the Romans and who killed or persecuted Jews who collaborated with the Romans

zealous.t: a. 热衷的, 热诚的, 热心的, 热情的
zealous.d: s marked by active interest and enthusiasm

zealously.t: adv. (正式)热心, 渴望, 积极, 热诚, 热情

zebedee.t: n. [基督教] 西庇太(《圣经·马太福音》中人物)

zebulun.t: n. 西布伦（雅各的第六个儿子）；泽布伦（男子名）

zechariah.d:
n. a Hebrew minor prophet of the late 6th century BC
n. an Old Testament book telling the prophecies of Zechariah which are concerned mainly with the renewal of Israel after the Babylonian Captivity

zedekiah.t: [男子名] 泽德凯亚来源于希伯来语，含义是“耶和华是力量”(Jehovah is might)

zeeb.t: abbr. Zeebrugge 泽布勒赫（比利时西北部港市）

zela.t: [地名] [土耳其] 泽拉（济莱的旧称）; [地名] [埃塞俄比亚、美国] 泽拉

zenas.t: [男子名] 泽纳斯来源于希腊语，含义是“希腊主神宙斯的礼物”(gift of Zeus,the chief Greek god)

zephaniah.d:
n. a Hebrew minor prophet of the late 7th century BC
n. an Old Testament book telling the prophecies of Zephaniah which are concerned mainly with the approaching judgment by God upon the sinners of Judah

zeus.d:
n. (Greek mythology) the supreme god of ancient Greek mythology; son of Rhea and Cronus whom he dethroned; husband and brother of Hera; brother of Poseidon and Hades; father of many gods; counterpart of Roman Jupiter
n. type genus of the family Zeidae

ziba.t: [地名] [坦桑尼亚、突尼斯、乌干达] 济巴

zillah.t: n. 专区(印度行政区划单位)
zillah.d: n. A district or local division, as of a province.

zilpah.t: n. [基督教]悉帕(《圣经·旧约》故事人物)

zin.t: abbr. zinc finger N-terminal 锌指氮基端

zion.t: n. 锡安山；耶路撒冷；基督教会；天国, 天堂
zion.d: n. originally a stronghold captured by David (the 2nd king of the Israelites); above it was built a temple and later the name extended to the whole hill; finally it became a synonym for the city of Jerusalem

zither.d: n. a musical stringed instrument with strings stretched over a flat sounding board; it is laid flat and played with a plectrum and with fingers

zoar.t: n. 避难所(见旧约创世记)

zohar.t: n. 《光明篇》(犹太神秘主义对摩西五书的注疏)
zohar.d:
n. A Jewish cabalistic book attributed by tradition to Rabbi
Simon ben Yochi, who lived about the end of the 1st century, a. d.
Modern critics believe it to be a compilation of the 13th century.

zophar.t: [人名] 琐法（《圣经》中的人物）

zur.t: abbr. Zurich 苏黎世; Zurigo (Italian=Zurich) （意大利语）苏黎世; Zurab 祖拉勃（男子名）; Zurr 祖尔（姓氏）
